organization: ISSOL, the International Society for the Study of the Origin of Life - The International Astrobiology Society
field: origins of life, origin of RNA and genetic polymers
why_relevant: society whose stated scope spans astronomy and molecular biology; its community is the natural audience for the RNA-then-DNA question
notes: use the institutional contact and membership routes; do not use officer emails even though the contact page lists them

why_relevant: public page that names the proper institutional channels for organisation and membership matters
notes: the page publishes personal officer addresses; they are deliberately not reproduced here; no bulk send

organization: ISSOL official journal page (OLEB, now Discover Life)
public_contact_or_submission: journal information and society journal status
why_relevant: identifies the society's journal lineage and its termination; useful for choosing a current submission venue
notes: OLEB ceased in 2023; its successor is Discover Life; not a contact point by itself, included as a venue-mapping aid

organization: Discover Life (Springer Nature, formerly Origins of Life and Evolution of Biospheres)
field: origins of life, molecular biology, astrobiology
public_contact_or_submission: manuscript submission via the journal page; 'Contact the journal' link
why_relevant: open-access journal whose scope explicitly includes molecular biology, genomics and astrobiology; a ground-visible submission route for a chemistry-and-history argument
notes: article processing charge applies; check current scope and fees before submitting; use the public submission link, not personal editorial addresses

organization: NASA Astrobiology Program, Ask an Astrobiologist
public_contact_or_submission: monthly live public question-and-answer show with a 'How to Ask' route
why_relevant: the program's own FAQ discusses the RNA world and the stability problem for synthetic genetic polymers; an opt-in audience rather than a purchased list
notes: site is being migrated to science.nasa.gov/astrobiology; check the current address before use; questions are public, so do not send unreleased claims you need protected

public_contact_or_submission: public mailing-list sign-up and program contact link on the site footer
why_relevant: program that funds and publishes prebiotic chemistry and origins research; public mailing list is an opt-in channel
notes: record a stage-1 verdict before sending any framing; a mailing list is not a substitute for a ground

organization: American Society for Biochemistry and Molecular Biology (ASBMB)
field: biochemistry and molecular biology, nucleic-acid chemistry
public_contact_or_submission: public contact page and annual-meeting abstract submission route linked from the society site
why_relevant: publishes nucleic-acid chemistry research and runs a large annual meeting; a ground-visible community for the stability and repair sub-claims
notes: use the public contact form and abstract route; one-to-one only; no ranking by likely agreement
